input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Polish: shared site header put Search on a row of its own on every page but the hub from 721px up; fixed with a container query on the header bar

errors.what: First version put the container on the <nav>; a before/after sweep of 79 pages showed 13 tool pages lost their one-row header (venture bars have no side padding, invisible to the nav's width).
errors.fix: Container moved to .pfs-bar (content box excludes padding); breakpoint 1017px; re-swept: no page taller at 320/390/900/1280.

errors.what: Post seo_title was over 70 characters while the full suite ran (8 test failures).
errors.fix: Shortened to 70; check_post_frontmatter.py rc=0; affected test files rerun 318/318.

doc_friction.issue: Item 3 said the Search pill wraps 'at 1,100px'; it wrapped at every width from 721px up on every page but the hub. Worth measuring a range of widths, not one.
Build time estimate of 3-20 min was right on the first build (~5 min); the second build ran in about 2 min. No problem, only a data point.

deviations.why: Did not rebuild the whole site after each CSS tweak; patched the two built stylesheets in dist with the same string change to re-measure, after one full rebuild with the main change.
deviations.did: sed/python replace of the changed rule in dist
deviations.result: Saved two ~5-minute rebuilds; the source and patched dist were checked to hold the same rules (grep counts).

notes: Measured with a 79-page Playwright sweep (70 tool pages + site sections) on before/after builds. Bar height median at 1280: 96 -> 88; worst 126 -> 88 at 900 and 1280; Search on the brand row at 1280: 24 -> 78 of 79; sideways scroll unchanged (2 pre-existing at 320). site-nav.test.mjs 18/18; full platform/pages suite: 1529/1552 pass, 15 skipped, 8 failed, all from this run's post seo_title being 74-81 chars mid-run; after fixing it to 70 the three affected files (build, custom-domain, heading-order) pass 318/318.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: front-end dev: measure header across widths, CSS container-query fix, sweep 79 pages before/after, test, write-up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
